pxc.title: Activities
pxc.subtitle: Interactive activities you built in Compose
pxc.emptyBody: Describe an activity in Compose and the assistant builds it for you.
pxc.notConfigured: Previews aren't set up on this server.
pxc.deleteDraftBody: This permanently deletes the activity and its preview data. You can't undo this.
pxc.deletePlacedBody: This activity has been placed in a course. Sparkth can't tell whether it is still there. If it is, learners will see an error in its place and lose their answers. You can't undo this.
